'''Karu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who resided on the ruined [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. At one point in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], she trained a rising [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who would eventually achieve the rank of [[Barsen'thor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Karu first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' for Republic allied classes. In the game, she serves as a trainer for the Jedi Consular class.
